name: lasagna
shortDescription: Layered spec-driven harness for Claude Code — precise specs, domain models, frozen contracts, and a red-green loop with isolated test and implementation roles.
longDescription: lasagna is a Claude Code plugin that brings structure to software development through spec-driven and test-driven loops. It enforces three human gates, mechanical isolation between test-writer and implementer, a fixed cycle budget per layer, and layering rules on the domain core. Works on greenfield projects and legacy codebases, supports Python/TypeScript/JVM/.NET.
